description: This PHP class defines a Drupal form for reviewing modules to be upgraded during a migration process. It gathers data about source modules, their upgrade status, and displays modules that will or will not be upgraded, providing a summary before executing the upgrade.

classes.name: ReviewForm
classes.description: A Drupal form class for reviewing modules before performing a migration upgrade, displaying modules to be upgraded or skipped, and initiating the upgrade process.

methods.name: getFormId
methods.description: Returns the unique ID of the form, 'migrate_drupal_ui_review_form'.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Builds the review form, gathering migration data, and displaying modules to be upgraded or skipped with status counters.

methods.name: submitForm
methods.description: Handles form submission, initiating the batch process for migration upgrade and redirecting to the front page.

methods.name: getConfirmText
methods.description: Returns the confirmation button text 'Perform upgrade'.

methods.name: prepareOutput
methods.description: Prepares and sorts migration state data for display, converting module machine names to human-readable names and formatting destination modules.
